findings.name: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
findings.detail: Accessed another user's data (/api/users/2) without ownership verification.
findings.remediation: Implement object-level authorization checks. Verify the requesting user owns the resource before returning data.

findings.name: BOLA — Order Resource
findings.detail: Order data accessible without ownership verification.
findings.remediation: Verify order ownership before returning order data.

findings.name: Missing Authentication
findings.detail: Protected endpoint /api/profile returns data without any authentication.
findings.remediation: Require valid JWT token for all non-public endpoints. Return 401 Unauthorized for missing tokens.

findings.name: JWT None Algorithm Attack
findings.detail: API accepts JWT tokens signed with 'none' algorithm, bypassing signature verification entirely.
findings.remediation: Explicitly reject 'none' algorithm in JWT validation. Use a strong secret and enforce HS256 or RS256.

findings.name: Excessive Data Exposure / Mass Assignment
findings.detail: API response contains sensitive fields that should never be returned: password, password_hash, ssn, credit_card
findings.remediation: Filter API responses to return only necessary fields. Never return password hashes, SSNs, or card numbers.

findings.name: Missing Rate Limiting
findings.detail: Sent 30 requests in 0.1s with no rate limiting response (no 429 status code returned).
findings.remediation: Implement rate limiting (e.g. 5 requests/minute per IP). Return 429 Too Many Requests. Consider account lockout after 5 failed attempts.

findings.name: Broken Function Level Authorization — /api/admin/users
findings.detail: Admin endpoint /api/admin/users accessible without admin role verification.
findings.remediation: Implement role-based access control (RBAC). Verify user role == 'admin' before processing admin requests.

findings.name: Broken Function Level Authorization — /api/admin/config
findings.detail: Admin endpoint /api/admin/config accessible without admin role verification.
findings.remediation: Implement role-based access control (RBAC). Verify user role == 'admin' before processing admin requests.

findings.name: Mass User Enumeration
findings.detail: Successfully enumerated 3 user records by iterating IDs (IDs accessed: [1, 2, 3]).
findings.remediation: Implement rate limiting per user. Use non-sequential UUIDs instead of integer IDs. Add CAPTCHA for high-volume requests.

findings.name: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
findings.remediation: Validate and whitelist allowed URL schemes and hosts. Block requests to internal IP ranges (RFC 1918) and metadata endpoints.

findings.name: Missing Security Headers
findings.evidence:
Missing headers:
  - X-Content-Type-Options (Prevents MIME-type sniffing attacks)
  - X-Frame-Options (Prevents clickjacking attacks)
  - Content-Security-Policy (Prevents XSS and injection attacks)
  - Strict-Transport-Security (Enforces HTTPS connections)
  - X-XSS-Protection (Legacy XSS protection for older browsers)
findings.remediation: Add all recommended security headers to every API response. Use a security headers middleware.

findings.name: CORS Wildcard Misconfiguration
findings.detail: API returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * allowing any domain to make cross-origin requests.
findings.remediation: Restrict CORS to specific trusted origins. Never use wildcard (*) for authenticated APIs.

findings.name: Improper Inventory Management — Hidden Endpoints
findings.detail: Discovered 5 undocumented or legacy endpoints through probing.
findings.remediation: Maintain an API inventory. Disable debug, legacy, and undocumented endpoints in production. Use API gateway to enforce endpoint allowlisting.

findings.name: SQL Injection — Boolean-based SQLi
findings.detail: SQL injection payload '' OR '1'='1' produced suspicious response.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements. Never concatenate user input into SQL strings. Use an ORM.

findings.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in API Response
findings.detail: API reflects unsanitised input in response — XSS payload returned unencoded.
findings.remediation: Sanitise all user input before returning in responses. Use Content-Security-Policy header. Encode output.

findings.name: JWT Weak Secret
findings.detail: JWT token signed with common/weak secret: 'secret123'
findings.remediation: Use a cryptographically random secret of at least 256 bits. Store it securely (env var or secrets manager). Rotate regularly.
